thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-16 continues the same geopolitical/economic drag: 'Iran war said to have cost EU 90bn euros in extra fuel costs,' plus EU-China trade-deficit friction commentary. These reinforce the multi-day caution theme rather than introducing a new actionable catalyst, and none of it is a reason to trim the small diversified VTI holding. The rest of the pack is single-name stock-picking listicles and routine politician PTR filings. Existing VTI position (~22.4 of ~107.4 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding through continued macro softness, consistent with capital preservation.
